authorization.request: 修复 DSH Desktop 插件商城完整目录搜索 im 时返回大量无关结果的问题；用户授权实际操作测试。

change.searchableFields: Search plugin IDs, names, aliases, package names, GitHub repositories, catalog search terms, candidate topics, categories, and descriptions; exclude review statuses, rejection reasons, recommendations evidence URLs, and internal listing explanations.
change.shortQueries: Queries of two characters or fewer search plugin identity, GitHub repository, and curated keywords; they do not scan long descriptions where common pairs create noise.
change.ranking: Require every whitespace-separated query term to match. Rank identity above repository, repository above curated keywords, and keywords above descriptions, preserving the selected board or directory sort as a stable tie-breaker.
change.boundary: No DSH core, @deepseek-ai dependency, real DSH Profile, installed package, install eligibility, package installation behavior, Loader, Fiber, or restart change.

verification.reproduction: On the running DSH Desktop 0.9.31 store, query im returned 4099 results with generic metadata and policy text ahead of title matches.
verification.regression: A disposable official-Desktop fixture verifies im excludes incidental description and moderation matches, image name matches rank before description-only matches, and installation review rationale is not searchable.
verification.full: npm run check passed: registry validation and 593 tests.
verification.desktopAcceptance: Pending merged 0.9.32 Catalog pin and official DSH Desktop update; verify im, image, installation, and exact plugin-name queries against live data.

rollback: Revert the source PR through an auditable CI-checked PR. Keep the 0.9.31 Catalog pin until a separate fresh release plan passes all deterministic gates.
backup: Isolated Git worktree and recoverable source history; no real DSH Profile, bundle, or restart mutation.
atomicCommit: One commit after scoped review, focused regression, npm run check, package dry-run, and git diff --check.

healthCheck.registry: REGISTRY_OK entries=875; npm run check passed with 593 tests.
